newsitem.title: FRANCE: Relatives of TWA crash plan Paris protest.
newsitem.headline: Relatives of TWA crash plan Paris protest.

text.p: The mother and brother of a Frenchman killed in a TWA airliner crash said on Monday they would spend New Year's Eve camped outside TWA's Paris offices to protest what they say is the airline's negligence towards them.

Odette and Olivier Michel said they had received no word from TWA since the burial of 28-year-old Pascal Michel, one of 230 people killed when Paris-bound flight 800 crashed into the Atlantic just after takeoff from New York on July 17.
The two left Montpellier in southern France on Monday planning to camp out overnight outside TWA's offices in Paris on Tuesday.
"They haven't even kept their financial promises to us," Olivier Michel said, accusing TWA of negligence towards the family and of failing to refund the cost of the funeral.
"When the television cameras were still around, the first victims buried had the right to real state funerals," he said.
Cause of the crash has never been officially established.
